note: Aim for about 20 queries: 8-10 should trigger, 8-10 should not. Negatives must be near-misses (sibling skills), not unrelated chatter. Split roughly 60% train / 40% validation. Do not paste failed-query keywords straight into the description.
should_trigger: A specialized, multi-step request that names the domain nouns this skill owns.
ניסוח עברי יומיומי שאמור להפעיל את ה-Skill גם בלי שם ה-Skill.
should_not_trigger: A near-miss that a different Snapland skill should handle.
